caption: The drawing depicts two views of a female doll-like figure positioned side by side on a plain, beige background. The left figure is shown from the front, while the right figure is in profile, facing left. Both figures have pale faces with small features and black hair styled in an updo. The neck and arms are elongated, with distinct joints visible at the shoulders and elbows. The bodies are painted in a light, flesh-colored tone resembling a corseted garment, with details like stitching and seams indicated by fine lines. Red bands encircle the upper arms and thighs, where the joints meet, and the legs below these bands are a muted greenish tone. The figures wear red shoes with defined soles, and the feet are slightly pointed. The arms and hands are relatively slender with minimal finger detail. The drawing uses muted, naturalistic colors with subtle shading to suggest form and volume, and the composition centers the two figures against a featureless background.
title: Doll
